name: Sour pho
summary: Phở chua is Cao Bang’s sour bowl, not a hot beef pho. Vietnam Tourism calls it sour noodle soup. Báo Cao Bằng builds it with roast duck, crisp belly, smoked sausage, and a vinegar sauce. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 21 May 2026 sets the bowl in this order: rice noodles, roast duck, crisp pork belly, and smoked sausage, then a little duck broth, then a vinegar sauce thickened with canna starch and seasoned with sugar, salt, garlic, and chili. Fried sweet-potato threads, crushed roasted peanut, shredded cucumber, and herbs go on last.

The 1 September 2026 article describes chewy noodles, duck, crisp fried potato, roasted peanut, herbs, and a sweet-sour dressing, and does not mention the duck broth. The 3 May 2026 article says roast meat, smoked sausage, roasted peanut, and a sweet-sour vinegar sauce. Vietnam Tourism’s English line is sour noodle soup.
A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Cao Bang city. The 3 May 2026 article says morning service in Thục Phán ward is limited. It does not print a clock. Check on arrival.
